events.title: One Car Photo Three Sizes
must_haves: Three separate images are delivered, rather than one collage.
The three frames have ratios of 1:1, 4:5 and 9:16 respectively.
Every version shows the same red hatchback from the attached photo.
The complete car, including roof, wheels and both ends, is visible in every version.
The car retains its original proportions and appearance in all versions.
Any padding is a blurred version of the source photo, and no version contains added text.

answer_sheet.Sizes and deliverables: Three separate images: 1:1, 4:5 and 9:16. A 640-pixel longest edge is fine.
answer_sheet.Subject to preserve: The whole red car, including both ends, roof and wheels.
answer_sheet.Padding and composition: Use blurred source-photo padding wherever cropping would cut off the car. Otherwise composition is your call.
answer_sheet.Style and wording: Preserve the original photo, with no added text or restyling.

events.text: I need this car pic made into three sizes, because I’m trying to get the same photo ready to use in a few places. I always worry about a car looking awkward when the picture gets resized. The versions I need are square, 4:5 for the feed, and 9:16 for stories, and I need them sent as three separate pictures. Please keep the whole car in each one rather than cutting any of it off. Blurred photo padding is fine if a crop won’t work. No text, please.
extras: I always worry about a car looking awkward when the picture gets resized.
